info.title: GreenTick Developer API
info.summary: WhatsApp messaging, contacts, workflows, and webhooks
info.description: Use GreenTick's REST API to send WhatsApp messages, synchronize contacts, trigger workflows, and receive signed event webhooks. Each API key belongs to one connected phone number.

post.description: Send a session text message or an approved WhatsApp template. Text messages require an open customer-service window; templates can start a conversation. GreenTick templates use named variables only. The to field is cleaned to digits and validated with country code (same rules as dashboard contacts) before calling WhatsApp. Template requests may include scheduledAt. An offset or Z is stored as that instant. A value without a zone is read in the account profile timezone from GET /api-key. Text messages cannot be scheduled.

templateDynamicUrl.summary: Example: Template with dynamic URL button

templateCopyCode.summary: Example: Template with copy code button

delete.description: Cancels a template that has not been sent yet. Refused in the last minute before the send time.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: scheduledId returned by POST /messages.

404.description: Scheduled template message not found

post.summary: Mark an inbound message as read
post.description: Sends a WhatsApp read receipt for one inbound message and clears the conversation unread count. messageId is messages[].id from GET /conversations/{id}/messages, the 24-character GreenTick id. Do not send messages[].wamid (it starts with wamid.) when id is present, and do not send the conversation id. A wamid is accepted only when you do not have id. To mark the whole thread, use POST /conversations/{id}/read.

phoneNumberRef.description: GreenTick phone line ref from GET /phone-numbers (ref field).

messageId.description: GreenTick inbound message id (messages[].id from GET /conversations/{id}/messages). A 24-character hex id such as 668f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d. Not the conversation id. A WhatsApp wamid (messages[].wamid, starts with wamid.) is accepted only when you do not have id.

404.description: Message not found

get.description: Lists WhatsApp inbox threads for a phone line, sorted by most recent activity. Uses cursor pagination.

parameters.name: phoneNumberRef
parameters.description: GreenTick phone line ref from GET /phone-numbers (ref field).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response nextCursor field.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Filter by contact name, phone number, or last message preview. Disables cursor pagination.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to fetch the next page. Null when there are no more results.

get.description: Fetches paginated message history for a conversation. Without before/after, returns the latest page. Use before to load older messages and after to load newer ones.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: GreenTick conversation ID.

parameters.name: phoneNumberRef
parameters.description: GreenTick phone line ref from GET /phone-numbers (ref field).

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Load messages older than this cursor (oldestCursor from a previous response).

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Load messages newer than this cursor (newestCursor from a previous response).

404.description: Conversation not found

get.description: Lists templates for the connected phone number on Meta, with their named variables and header requirements. Returns APPROVED templates by default; pass status=all for every status. Filter with name and language query params (name + language uniquely identifies a template).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on template name

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Exact language filter. Template name + language is the unique combination.

post.summary: Create a message template and submit it to Meta
post.description: Compiles a plain template payload, enforces dashboard character limits, probes URL buttons, and submits the template. A PENDING result blocks send until Meta approves it. Call POST /templates/validate first.

200.description: Template submitted or structured error envelope

get.description: Returns valid: true when the Bearer API key is active. Invalid, revoked, and expired keys receive 401. An expired GreenTick plan receives 403.

timeZone.description: Account profile IANA timezone. Empty until the customer sets Account timezone. Use it to interpret an unqualified scheduledAt.

get.description: Lists the connected WhatsApp phone number with Meta profile fields stored by GreenTick. Filter with ref or id query params to narrow to one line.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: GreenTick phone line id (ref field). Use as phoneNumberRef when sending.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Meta WhatsApp phone_number_id

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based page number

409.description: A contact with the same phone number exists

patch.description: Updates active contacts only. Soft-deleted contacts are treated as permanently removed (404). The deleted flag cannot be set via the API. If labels or attributes are included, every id must exist for the connected phone number (from GET /labels and GET /attributes) or the request fails with 400.

404.description: One or more contacts not found

get.description: Fetches one active contact by GreenTick id. Soft-deleted contacts are treated as permanently removed (404).

post.description: The gthook_ secret in the URL authenticates this request. Do not also send a GreenTick API key. The workflow must be active and use the Webhook event trigger.

post.description: Creates an outbound webhook for this API key's WhatsApp Business account. Zapier and Make.com call this when a Zap or scenario is turned on. The signing secret is returned once.

delete.description: Deletes a webhook subscription for this API key's WhatsApp Business account. Missing subscriptions return success so Zapier and Make can turn off cleanly.

apiKey.description: Create an API key in GreenTick Developer settings. Send it as Authorization: Bearer gt_live_… (Bearer prefix required).

phoneNumber.description: Phone number normalized to digits, including country code

attributes.description: Custom attribute values. Each id must come from GET /attributes.

phoneNumber.description: E.164 is recommended. GreenTick stores digits including country code.
Optional. When set, normalized to digits including country code.

to.description: Recipient phone with country code. Non-digits are stripped and leading zeros removed, then validated (e.g. +91 98765 43210 → 919876543210). Invalid numbers return 400 INVALID_TO.

phoneNumberRef.description: GreenTick phone line ref from GET /phone-numbers (ref field).

to.description: Recipient phone with country code. Non-digits are stripped and leading zeros removed, then validated (e.g. +91 98765 43210 → 919876543210). Invalid numbers return 400 INVALID_TO.

phoneNumberRef.description: GreenTick phone line ref from GET /phone-numbers (ref field).

language.description: Template language code. Name + language uniquely identifies the template.

variables.description: Named variable map for header and body placeholders. Keys must match variables[].name from GET /templates (e.g. customer_name, order_id). Button-specific values use template.dynamicURLVariable and template.copyCodeVariable.

dynamicURLVariable.description: Suffix value for dynamic URL buttons ({{1}}). Required when GET /templates returns requiresDynamicURLVariable: true.

copyCodeVariable.description: Coupon or code copied to the clipboard. Required when GET /templates returns requiresCopyCodeVariable: true. Max 20 characters.

headerMediaUrl.description: Optional public URL for header media when the template has an IMAGE, VIDEO, or DOCUMENT header. When omitted, GreenTick sends the template's approved sample media (header.example). Required only when GET /templates returns header.requiresMediaUrl: true. GreenTick verifies type and size before send: JPEG/PNG max 5 MB, MP4 max 16 MB, PDF max 100 MB.

scheduledAt.description: Optional ISO datetime for a template only. Include an offset or Z to store that instant, for example 2026-10-25T09:00:00-04:00. Without a zone, the time is read in the account profile timezone. Must be at least 5 minutes from now and within 30 days. A success returns scheduled, scheduledAt, and scheduledId and does not mean the message was delivered.

parameterFormat.description: GreenTick templates always use named variables.

requiresMediaUrl.description: When true, sending requires template.headerMediaUrl because no approved sample media is available. When false for a media header, headerMediaUrl is optional and the approved sample is used. Limits: IMAGE JPEG/PNG 5 MB, VIDEO MP4 16 MB, DOCUMENT PDF 100 MB.

example.description: Sample media URL from template approval when available (empty string if Meta only stored a media handle). Sent automatically when template.headerMediaUrl is omitted.

text.description: Body text. For AUTHENTICATION templates Meta uses fixed OTP copy; text may be empty or the resolved preset string.

addSecurityRecommendation.description: AUTHENTICATION only. When true, the template includes “For your security, do not share this code.”

footer.description: Footer text and/or AUTHENTICATION code expiration. Null when the template has no footer.

codeExpirationMinutes.description: AUTHENTICATION only. Minutes until the OTP expires (shown as “This code expires in N minutes.”).

otpType.description: Present for AUTHENTICATION OTP buttons when Meta returns otp_type.

variable.description: Placeholder key in the URL for dynamic URL buttons (always {{1}}).

example.description: Sample value from template approval (dynamic URL suffix or COPY_CODE).

requiresVariable.description: When true, pass template.copyCodeVariable when sending.

variables.description: Named variables to supply in template.variables when sending (header and body). Each entry includes the Meta approval sample.

requiresDynamicURLVariable.description: When true, POST /messages must include template.dynamicURLVariable. Use buttons[].example for the sample suffix.

requiresCopyCodeVariable.description: When true, POST /messages must include template.copyCodeVariable.

example.description: Sample value from Meta template approval. Empty string when none was provided.

contactWaId.description: Customer WhatsApp ID (digits with country code).

sessionExpiresAt.description: End of the WhatsApp customer-care session window.

ConversationMessage.description: Normalized message row. Returned on POST /messages (data.message) and in GET /conversations/{id}/messages.

id.description: GreenTick message id. Pass this to POST /messages/read. Not the conversation id.

wamid.description: WhatsApp message id. Starts with wamid. Do not send this to POST /messages/read when id is present.

type.description: text | template | image | video | document | audio | sticker | …

MessageTemplatePayload.description: Sent template snapshot on template messages. Not the same as the GET /templates catalog object.

components.description: Approved Meta template structure (HEADER, BODY, FOOTER, BUTTONS) with placeholders.

variableValues.description: Resolved named variables used when the message was sent.

headerComponent.description: Send-time header component for media headers (image/video/document link or id).

MessageDeliveryHistoryEntry.description: One delivery state change on an outbound message, ordered oldest to newest.

errorCode.description: Meta error code when status is failed.

errorTitle.description: Short error title when status is failed.

errorMessage.description: Human-readable error detail when status is failed.

ref.description: GreenTick phone line ID — pass as phoneNumberRef when sending messages

metaPhoneNumberId.description: Optional Meta phone-number ID when the workflow is not pinned to a line.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, or revoked API key

Forbidden.description: Plan expired (PLAN_EXPIRED) or phone number is not this API key’s connected phone number

PlanExpired.description: The phone number owner’s plan has expired. Renew to restore API and webhook access.

example.message: Your plan has expired. Renew your plan to restore this feature.

delivery.note: Outbound webhooks are paused while the phone number owner's plan is expired. Handlers should acknowledge quickly and process asynchronously.
